message:
docs(field): correct the 0.2.100 field-test report -- wire/user-feedback lines are samples, population fps from udpTxFrames, no capture->wire sum, upload timeline, relay vs P2P cause, UAC fix scope

Supervisor review (Codex remote#wslm89zu) of 7af3a21:
- host_encoded_sender.cpp:218 logs 'wire seq' only for keyframes or a wire interval >1.5x the
  target, so 1,388/989 were samples; the 'med 29 ms = 34 fps' conversion and sample p95 are
  withdrawn. Population figures now come from udpTxFrames/udpTxBytes deltas: ~4.5 fps on the
  static/typing stretch, 58 fps and 36-38 Mbps during the video (3x the 12 Mbps target).
- The 'capture->wire = 15-20 ms' estimate summed medians of unrelated samples and is removed;
  pipeUs is sendQpc - captureQpc (encoder hold included) and is kept as a sample, not dismissed
  as an inter-AU gap; the whole distribution is unmeasured.
- Viewer/client NAS lines stop at 13:47/13:48, before the 13:56 restart: the restart cannot
  explain the first gap; Bearer loss is only a candidate for the continued failure; no viewer-
  side 401 is on record; 'not recoverable' narrowed to 'no uploader retransmit, no NAS copy'
  (local originals recoverable by hand).
- Relay use (fact) separated from the P2P failure cause (undetermined; follow-up analysis plan
  instead of a port-forwarding prescription).
- UAC fix: use the capture target's current physical rect+origin; rect=0 fallback and the
  target==virt check are single-monitor-only conditions.
